row:
Thank for your interest in The Business of Massage on YouTube!

My name is Esteban Gonzalez, I’ve been a massage therapist for 20 years and I’m here to bring you tips and tools to help motivate, educate, and equip you to better serve others, so whether you’re just starting your career as a massage therapist or you’ve been at it a while, I want to help you stand out and take your practice to the next level! 

My mission is to help 10,000 purpose driven massage therapists make a full-time living doing what they love and making an impact through the power of massage. 

Here are the ways to work with me:

⚡️COACHING/CONSULTING: Reach out to me via email if you are looking to connect. 

⚡️COURSES: Coming Soon!

⚡️FREE CLASS: Coming Soon!

Never Stop Learning - Talk Soon.
